office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Garfield County for the state and is the legal adviser to county officers and boards.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Matt L. Newberg, elected unopposed in 2018 and 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Garfield County Prosecuting Attorney since 2018, running unopposed; he submitted no statement to the voters' guide.
highlights: Graduate of Eastern Washington University and Gonzaga University School of Law [S5]
